capabilities: Resize table width by dragging the right edge without changing text size
Scale whole table, text and formulas from 50% to 150% via bottom edge or corner
Save and restore each table's layout across sessions, panes and views
Reset width, scale or both with double-clicks or keyboard shortcuts
Keep layouts through file and folder renames or moves inside the vault
extras: Stores layouts locally in data.json with hashed table identifiers; no network requests or telemetry. Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.7+); mobile support disabled; Windows is the primary test platform, macOS and Linux need validation. Raw HTML tables and plugin-generated tables are out of scope.
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown tables at fixed widths, so wide tables overflow or squeeze content, and no per-table layout is remembered between sessions.
summary: Drag-and-drop resizer that adjusts Markdown table width or scales whole tables with text and formulas, remembering each table's layout.
